title: Pooling and Normalization via CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: For pooling protocol: transfer dna according to csv.

steps.title: Prepare transfer CSV
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file with two header rows before the transfer data. For a normalization run, include the word "normalization" in the top row; for a pooling run, include the word "pooling" in the top row. Ensure every transfer volume is greater than 1.0 µL and set the volume to "0" for wells that should be skipped. Use the provided example CSVs as templates.

steps.title: Normalize by transferring water and DNA
steps.instruction: For the normalization protocol, transfer the water volume specified in the CSV using a single pipette tip, then transfer the DNA volume for each well using a fresh tip per well, following the CSV entries.

substeps.instruction: Transfer water (use one tip for all wells).
Transfer DNA (use a new tip for each well) according to the CSV.

steps.title: Pool DNA according to CSV
steps.instruction: For the pooling protocol, transfer DNA to the destination wells exactly as specified in the CSV file.
